Independent scientific review

I inspected the remote repository CartmanFatass/My-paper-code at the exact GitHub-reachable commit 2b8f1ae0ea8c514bd333c45fe11275a2fabfbb81 and read the six named references at that revision. I did not inspect or use the quarantined B3 package.

Bottom-line judgment

The best-supported branch is: no decision-relevant link specificity after the simpler null.

The frozen two-family comparison is mathematically valid under its prioritized exact-transform definition:

The exact exponential exposure family materially beats one shared raw per-opportunity probability by approximately 0.125331, well above the 1/32 margin.

That result does not identify the exponential link as the valuable structure.

A same-dimensional, state-blind common executed-rate family,

reaches both unrestricted grid optima simultaneously at h=3/16, obtains mean return approximately 0.498786, and exceeds the best exponential policy by approximately 0.017262.

The latter difference is below 1/32, so the exponential rule is not materially inferior to the simpler null—but it has no demonstrated direct-return advantage over it either.

Thus the exact result supports generic physical-time adjustment or a global physical event-rate operating point, not the specific exponential survival-compounding link.

The investment implication is therefore:

Close the distinct exponential-link claim and, at most, narrow the direction to a generic global physical-rate hypothesis. Do not continue investing in the link as a specialized mechanism on this evidence.

This is consistent with, but not proved by, the earlier repository context. B1 records a positive ONLGR-versus-RAW activation but no timing/content or eligible-exposure-link composite activation. B2 explicitly used the same exponential link in both arms and stated that its comparison could not validate that link against another normalization; its completed result activated ABSORB_TO_GLOBAL_RATE after the material positive gate failed.

3. Which coordinate defines “one global operating point”?

Raw boundary probability is not an invariant operating coordinate when opportunity frequency changes.

In raw coordinates, the near-sets are separated by 7/16. But converting them to expected executed events per physical tick gives:

fast near-set: {3/16};

slow near-set:

{10/64,11/64,12/64,13/64,14/64}.

They overlap exactly at

3/16=12/64.

So the near-set distance is zero in physical executed-rate coordinates.

There are actually three different notions that must not be conflated:

Boundary probability: q.

Expected executed-event rate: q/Δ.

Survival-compounding intensity: −log(1−q)/Δ.

The exponential family makes the third quantity common. The linear family makes the second common. Neither makes raw q common.

For this study’s objective, the most decision-relevant coordinate is q/Δ, because:

physical service age advances per physical tick;

action cost per physical tick is 2q/Δ;

the optimum in each stratum happens to share that quantity.

Therefore:

A frozen stop explicitly defined in raw boundary probability may be reported as mechanically passed, but it should not be interpreted as evidence against “one global operating point” without naming the coordinate.

The scientifically meaningful conclusion here is one common executed-renewal-rate operating point on the frozen grid, not one common raw boundary probability.

4. Is the common-rate family impermissibly post-scope?

It is both post-scope and scientifically mandatory, in different senses.

It is post-scope for the registered primary contrast. It must not be retroactively presented as a prospectively registered arm, used to rewrite thresholds, or used to say that the exact exposure-versus-per-opportunity result did not occur. That primary result remains:

Exact exponential exposure materially beats one shared raw per-opportunity probability.

But it is mandatory for the resulting scientific interpretation and investment decision because it is:

one-parameter;

state-blind and memoryless;

exposed to exactly the same physical spacings;

no more expressive in parameter count;

based on the coordinate directly appearing in the action-cost term;

capable of reproducing both unrestricted grid optima.

A concrete post hoc mathematical counterexample can lower a mechanistic claim even when it cannot rewrite a preregistered result label. This is especially strong here because there is no sampling noise or flexible statistical analysis: the comparator’s consequences are exhaustively determined.

Accordingly, the correct record should preserve both statements:

Frozen primary finding: exposure transform > shared raw boundary probability.

Scientific convergence finding: that contrast does not identify link specificity once the common executed-rate null is considered.

The common-rate family would be impermissible only if it were silently relabelled as part of the original frozen design. It is not impermissible as a falsifier of a broader causal or investment interpretation.

5. Positive control or tautology?

The result is not a pure tautology, but it is a low-specificity positive control.

It is not logically guaranteed that the exponential family must beat the per-opportunity family:

renewal costs can make increased slow-stratum event probability harmful;

nonstacking renewal can waste early events;

grid restrictions can prevent the useful transformed probability;

under the literal output-grid reading, the ordering reverses;

a different service/action timing convention could change the objective.

Nevertheless, the host strongly builds in the need for some physical-time correction. A shared raw p produces a fourfold difference in expected events per physical tick between the two strata, while the plan lifetime is explicitly eight physical ticks. The raw family is therefore structurally dose-mismatched.

The exponential win is useful for showing that:

the host contains direct renewal value;

physical opportunity frequency matters;

the calculation responds in the expected direction;

a physical-time-aware family can recover much of the lost slow-stratum service.

It has little value for deciding that the exponential link deserves separate investment, because the same advantage is reproducible—and improved—by a simpler physical-rate parameterization.

So the strongest characterization is:

A useful positive control for physical-time normalization, but not evidence of specialized exponential-link value.

The B2 source reinforces the distinction: both B2 learned arms deliberately shared the exponential map, and the science card explicitly says its comparison could not identify or validate that link against another one. The model definition implements precisely that shared exact map.

It does not imply equal numbers of opportunities:

Δ=4: one callback per four physical ticks.

Thus the fast stratum performs four times as many policy invocations per unit physical time.

That asymmetry is appropriate for the stated direct-return estimand because computation is not included in J. It becomes material only if the claim is extended to work, optimization exposure, latency, or resource-normalized performance.

Dummy-call work

The fixed-q shell matches the nominal event charges in the algebra. That alone does not establish matched work.

A work-matched shell would need to establish, separately, that it performs:

the same policy forward at every callback;

the same event sampling;

the same action dispatch and bookkeeping;

the same payload-handling path up to the intentional null;

the same callback-frequency-dependent work.

The repository host records actor calls and dummy-call ledgers separately, and the science card explicitly requires actor-sized dummy forwards at masked callbacks. That is the appropriate standard for a workload claim.

For this exact structural study, the distinction does not alter direct return. It does block interpreting the shell as evidence against generic compute, exposure-count, or optimization-regularization explanations.

This is a material specification defect because it changes the sign of the result. Its scientific disposition is:

It does not invalidate the exact-transform conclusion, because the stated durable definition explicitly resolves the hierarchy in favor of exact transformation.

It sharply limits that conclusion to “base-only grid restriction with an unprojected transformed probability.”

It forbids paraphrasing the result as applying to a design in which “all resulting probabilities lie in Q.”

Had there been no pre-existing authority hierarchy resolving the conflicting clauses, the study would have been definition-ambiguous rather than cleanly positive.

The durable wording should be: “Base parameters lie in Q; transformed probabilities are evaluated exactly and need not lie in Q.”

8. Branch resolution
Candidate branch	Resolution
Structural collapse	Qualified. The registered family contrast does not collapse, but the link-specific interpretation collapses in physical executed-rate coordinates on the frozen grid.
No direct headroom	Rejected for the host overall. The common-rate policy improves on the exponential one, and the deterministic age-aware controller reaches 0.75.
One global operating point	Supported only in physical executed-rate coordinates. Unsupported in raw boundary probability.
Material per-opportunity advantage	Rejected. The per-opportunity family loses by about 0.125331.
Material exposure-linked advantage	Passed only for exposure versus the prespecified raw-p family. It does not survive as a link-specific advantage over the competent null.
No decision-relevant link specificity after the simpler null	Selected branch. This is the narrowest interpretation consistent with all exact evidence.

The deterministic 0.75 ceiling is important for interpreting “headroom.” It shows that the policy problem still has substantial direct-return headroom, but that headroom is associated with age conditioning rather than with choosing exponential instead of common-rate memoryless parameterization.

9. Is executable evidence still needed?

For the mathematical object as defined, no sampled execution can change the current branch. Exhaustive rational enumeration and exact arithmetic determine:

every grid argmax;

every near-set;

every family optimum;

every margin comparison;

the common-rate counterexample;

the literal-grid reversal.

Repeating the same object through Monte Carlo would add numerical error, not information.

An executable observation could still discover that an implementation does not instantiate the frozen object—for example:

transformed probabilities were rounded or projected;

service age had an off-by-one convention;

action cost was charged on a different tick;

physical-time strata were weighted by opportunity count;

the shell retained a service reset;

dummy calls skipped work assumed to be matched.

Such an observation would be an implementation-conformance failure. It would not overturn the exact algebra; it would break the mapping from the implementation to the defined study.

The repository references provide useful conformance evidence: the registered actor uses the exact unprojected exponential calculation, and the host advances age in physical ticks while separately recording service, action cost, actor calls, and dummy calls.

10. Narrowest defensible claim

Within the exact two-stratum, equal-physical-time, eight-tick-lifetime, two-unit-cost, state-blind memoryless Q-grid construction, selecting a base r∈Q and applying the exact unprojected transform q
4
	​

4
 materially outperforms using one shared raw boundary probability. This establishes value for correcting opportunity-frequency mismatch, but not value specific to the exponential link: a one-parameter common executed-renewal-rate family reaches both unrestricted grid optima and is slightly better.

Nothing in this result establishes learned ONLGR value, RAW representational impossibility, a literal hazard process, causal lease value, causal rebinding value, general callback-period behavior, variable-population behavior, UAV transfer, safety, or PPO superiority.

Strongest supporting evidence

The exposure-versus-raw contrast is large and exact: +0.125331, with a service increase much larger than the additional event cost. The raw near-optimal boundary probabilities are also widely separated, and the exposure and raw family curves share no nondegenerate policy.

Strongest contradicting evidence

The common-rate family has the same parameter dimension, reaches both unrestricted grid optima, and is better than the exposure family. The raw near-set separation vanishes when expressed as executed events per physical tick. The literal output-grid reading reverses the family ordering. Finally, the age-aware controller demonstrates that the major remaining headroom lies outside all three memoryless families.

Remaining alternatives and common dependencies

The observed exposure-versus-raw advantage remains jointly attributable to:

generic callback-frequency correction;

equalization of survival over physical exposure;

a common physical action-rate budget;

the coarse 1/16 parameter grid;

eight being divisible by both spacings;

nonstacking service lifetime;

linear per-event cost;

equal physical-time weighting;

stationary independent Bernoulli actions;

exclusion of computation from return;

exact rather than projected transformation;

the frozen action/service ordering.

The current evidence does not separate these into a unique causal mechanism.

11. Smallest genuinely new discriminator

There is no new discriminator needed to decide the current frozen branch.

If the broader generic-rate hypothesis remains strategically important, the smallest scientifically new object would be one prospectively frozen exact robustness cell changing only one physical axis, such as lifetime or event cost, with all three one-parameter families included from the outset:

shared raw p,exact exponential,common executed rate.

It should:

use an explicit base-only Q rule;

predeclare physical event rate as the operating-point coordinate;

be selected by an outcome-independent rule;

require an ex ante exponential-versus-common-rate separation of at least 1/32;

remain exact rather than sampled.

If no fresh cell satisfying those conditions exists, that is itself a reason to park the link question rather than launch another implementation.

Investment disposition

Do not continue the distinct exponential link. Close it as a separately supported direct-value mechanism. Narrow the surviving research object to a generic global physical-rate hypothesis; park that broader object as well unless value beyond this constructed positive control is strategically important.
